positioning: AI Done Right makes it easy to use the right model, the right method, and the right cost for every AI task — instead of sending everything to the most expensive model. Teleon is the runtime that makes any capability efficient (descend it to the cheapest bounded path that still meets the bar); Baltor is the engine that makes it trustworthy; the Open*Hubs are the open component registries both consume.
mission: Most teams build AI the expensive, one-size-fits-all way. AI Done Right makes the right way the easy way: write a capability in plain language and the system picks the right model and method for the task — deterministic rules and cheap models before frontier LLMs, the frontier reserved for supervision — governed end to end.
brand_laws: Teleon governs what becomes EFFICIENT — the cheapest bounded path (the descent brain).
